name: Membership Query Complexity of Universal Class
proof: A binary membership-query decision tree of depth r has at most $2^r$ leaves, giving r at least $\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$. Conversely, at every stage choose a subset A of the surviving indices with sizes as balanced as possible and query A. The answer from target $u_i$ says exactly whether i lies in A, so this binary search identifies i in $\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ queries.
